sermon.title: Out of Darkness - January 21, 2024
sermon.speaker: Unidentified speaker (not clearly Pastor Kincer)
sermon.summary: Starting from Gideon and the multitude around the throne, the message sets eternal priorities: we will all stand before God, only names in the Lamb’s Book of Life enter, and God’s mercy is not approval of sin. Fear God, keep His commandments, and pursue righteousness. The recording then includes a worship set about clean hands and pure hearts.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: The recording puts the message first (from 0:06) and a worship set after it (from ~47:37); kept in recording order.
